problem: Slop had one hard-wired Parking Jam experience and no reusable character movement or automatic proximity-interaction base for tycoon-style games.
reuseDecision: Keep the validated Modoki build shell and Parking Jam implementation, add one shared pure proximity-world domain, route both games through a lightweight hub, and build an original junkyard-station vertical slice without copying proprietary code or assets.
nonGoals: Copy proprietary MSN, Homa, or StoreRider source code, branding, levels, models, sounds, or textures
Implement offline income, employees, upgrades, multiple locations, ads, or monetization in the first vertical slice
Merge PR #1 or replace Modoki and Three.js
acceptance: The default route renders a touch-safe hub with Parking Jam and Junkyard Station cards
Legacy Parking Jam seed and viewport links still open Parking Jam without requiring a game parameter
A pure reusable domain owns bounded movement, nearest ready interaction selection, sustained progress, cooldown, and completion events
Junkyard Station supports keyboard and touch movement plus automatic talk, junk clearing, construction, fueling, and cash collection interactions
Domain tests cover the reusable proximity base and the complete starter tycoon loop
Production browser checks enter the hub, launch Junkyard Station, move the real character into a junk interaction, observe domain progress, return home, and launch Parking Jam
